name: Delete Lattice Data
description: Delete a value at a writable lattice path (w/, o/, n/, t/), or remove one of your own secrets (s/NAME — whole records only). Example: w/scratch/temp-data (clean up workspace). Idempotent — deleting a non-existent path is a no-op.

path.description: Path to delete. Must start with w/, o/, n/, or t/; s/NAME deletes one of your own secrets (whole records only).

output.description: Delete removes only the addressed value and never prunes parent hierarchy.

deleted.description: True if a value was present at the path and removed; false if the path was already absent (idempotent no-op).
